item.title: 10 Mississippi law enforcement agencies receive $100K each
item.description: BOLTON, Miss. (WJTV) - U.S. Rep. Bennie Thompson (D-Miss.) announced a major investment in local law enforcement agencies in Mississippi. A total of $1 million will be distributed to 10 departments. They will each receive a $100,000 check. item.title: FEMA mobilizes resources for Mississippi winter storm recovery
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) said they're moving additional resources into Mississippi to help residents recover from the winter storm. Acting Regional Administrator Rob Ashe said FEMA is working closely with the Mississippi Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) to meet every request. item.title: Mississippi SNAP recipients can apply for replacement benefits after winter storm
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - The Mississippi Department of Human Services( MDHS) said SNAP recipients, who experienced a power outage for more than four hours due to Winter Storm Form on Jan. 24, 2026, can apply for SNAP replacement benefits. The applications must be submitted by February 3, 2026, which is 10 days from the date of the storm. [...]
